description: Bounded applicant-ranked popular matching with ties, private last resorts, and the rank-one maximum-cardinality condition.

source.title: Ranked Matching
source.algorithm_attribution: Popular-Matching characterization for ranked bipartite applicants and posts
source.implementation_status: clean-room bounded profile; no book prose or source code copied

input.rank_range: 1..post_count, with contiguous rank groups per applicant; equal ranks encode ties
input.input_rules: Edge pairs are distinct, IDs are zero based, every applicant has a nonempty list, and ranks have no gaps. Each applicant receives one private last-resort post below all listed ranks.

output.encoding: [found,assignment_by_applicant]; real post IDs are 0..post_count-1, private last resort for applicant a is post_count+a, and no-solution uses found=0 with every assignment -1

workspace.meaning: Fixed preference/rank matrices, rank-one matching, alternating classes, reduced edges, and exhaustive assignments for at most four applicants and four real posts.

contract.alternating_forest: Root at every unmatched applicant and post in the rank-one graph; traverse nonmatching edges from even vertices and matching edges from odd vertices. Private last-resort posts are isolated even vertices.
contract.reduced_graph: For each applicant retain all rank-one posts and all most-preferred even posts, including the private last resort only when it is among those most-preferred even posts; delete odd-odd and odd-unreachable edges.
contract.acceptance: Return an applicant-complete matching in the filtered reduced graph whose rank-one edge subset has cardinality equal to the maximum matching size of the rank-one graph.
contract.tie_break: Return the lexicographically smallest assignment vector among qualifying matchings, with real post IDs before private last-resort IDs.
